sections.heading: Pratham Khand - “Ye Nahi, Ye Nahi” Ki Komal Disha
blocks: Pichhle adhyay me humne ahankar ki paratein dekhi. Ahankar sirf ghamand nahi hai. Ahankar sharir, mann, naam, role, image, kahani, experience aur spiritual identity tak se “main” bana leta hai. Kabhi woh kehta hai - “main sharir hoon.” Kabhi - “mere thoughts hi main hoon.” Kabhi - “meri role hi main hoon.” Kabhi - “meri kahani hi main hoon.” Kabhi - “mujhe gyaan hua, isliye main special hoon.”

Humne ye bhi dekha ki ahankar se ladna nahi hai. Use maarna nahi hai. Use sakshi-bhav me dekhna hai. Jo clearly dekha jata hai, uski pakad dheere-dheere dhili hoti hai. Ab yahi yatra aur gehri hogi. Ab hum us direction me chalenge jise Advaita Vedanta me Neti-Neti kaha gaya hai.

Neti-Neti ka arth hai - ye nahi, ye nahi. Lekin ise rejection mat samajhna. Ye life ko deny karna nahi hai, duniya se bhaagna nahi hai, sharir se nafrat nahi hai, mann ko dabana nahi hai, relations ko chhodna nahi hai. Neti-Neti ka arth hai - jo main nahi hoon, use clarity se pehchanna, taki jo main hoon woh apne aap clear hone lage. Ye identity ki safai hai.

Jab sadhak kehta hai “main sharir nahi hoon”, iska matlab sharir bekaar nahi. Sharir life ka instrument hai. Use food, rest, care aur treatment chahiye. Isi sharir ke through sadhana bhi ho rahi hai. Lekin sharir badalta hai. Bachpan ka sharir gaya, jawani ka sharir bhi badlega, budhapa aayega. Sharir experience me aata hai, sharir jaana jata hai. Isliye sadhak dheere se dekhta hai - “sharir mera experience hai, final swaroop nahi.” Ye Neti hai.

Jab sadhak kehta hai “main mann nahi hoon”, iska matlab mann enemy nahi. Mann se language samajh aati hai, planning hoti hai, learning hoti hai, baat-cheet hoti hai. Lekin mann bhi badalta hai. Thoughts aate-jaate hain, emotions uthte-shaant hote hain, memories aur desires badalte hain. Isliye sadhak dekhta hai - “mann bhi experience me aata hai. Main use jaan sakta hoon. Isliye mann final swaroop nahi.” Ye bhi Neti hai.

Neti-Neti ka matlab kisi cheez ko kaat dena nahi. Iska matlab hai - use uske sahi place par rakhna. Sharir hai, par main sirf sharir nahi. Mann hai, par main sirf mann nahi. Emotion hai, par main sirf emotion nahi. Thought hai, par main sirf thought nahi. Role hai, par main sirf role nahi. Kahani hai, par main sirf kahani nahi. Ye clarity jitni gehri hoti hai, sadhak utna halka hota hai.

Bahut log Neti-Neti ko harsh denial samajh lete hain. Unhe lagta hai sabko reject karna hai, body ignore karni hai, mann stop karna hai, emotions avoid karne hain, duniya ko jhooth bolkar side kar dena hai. Ye direction sahi nahi. “Main sharir nahi hoon” kehkar body neglect karna samajh nahi. “Main mann nahi hoon” kehkar emotions dabana samajh nahi. “Sab Maya hai” kehkar dusron ke dukh se insensitive hona bhi incomplete understanding hai.

Neti-Neti loving inquiry hai. Jaise almari saaf karte waqt tum har vastu ko dekhte ho. Kuch useful, kuch purani, kuch unnecessary. Tum objects se ladte nahi. Bas samajhte ho kya kahan rakhna hai. Neti-Neti bhi andar ki almari saaf karne jaisa hai. Sharir ko sharir ke place par, mann ko mann ke place par, role ko role ke place par, kahani ko kahani ke place par rakho. Inme se kisi ko final “main” mat banao.

Neti-Neti ki simple kasauti hai: jo badalta hai, woh mera final swaroop nahi ho sakta. Sharir badalta hai, mann badalta hai, emotions badalte hain, thoughts badalte hain, roles badalte hain, image badalti hai, kahani ka meaning badalta hai, spiritual experiences bhi aate-jaate hain. To inme se koi final “main” nahi.

Ab dekho - ye sab badalte hue bhi kuch hai jo changes ko jaanta hai. Bachpan ka sharir badla, jaana gaya. Mann ki state badli, jaani gayi. Dukh aaya-gaya, jaana gaya. Success aayi-gayi, jaani gayi. Role badli, jaani gayi. Spiritual experience aaya, jaana gaya. To sadhak poochta hai - jo jaana ja raha hai, kya main wahi hoon? Ya main woh hoon jo ise jaan raha hai? Ye Neti-Neti ka heart hai.

Kapdon ka example lo. Tum kapde badalte ho. Kapde tumhare hain, par tum kapde nahi. Achchhe kapde pehne to “main achcha”, purane kapde pehne to “main kam” - ye confusion hai. Life me hum sharir, mann, role aur image ko bhi kapdon ki tarah pehente hain, lekin unhe “main” maan lete hain. Neti-Neti kehti hai - in garments ko pehchano, use karo, respect do, par final identity mat banao.

Nadi ka example lo. Tum kinare baithe ho, paani beh raha hai. Patte, phool, lakdi, mitti sab behkar aate-jaate hain. Agar har cheez ko pakadkar kaho “ye main hoon”, restless ho jaoge. Thoughts aur emotions bhi aise hi flow hain. “Main successful hoon”, “main failure hoon”, “mujhe respect chahiye”, “main spiritual hoon.” Neti-Neti kehti hai - ye thought bhi nahi, ye emotion bhi nahi, ye kahani bhi nahi, ye role bhi nahi.

Neti-Neti me komalta chahiye. Sharir ko blame mat karo. Mann ko enemy mat banao. Role ko reject mat karo. Kahani ka apmaan mat karo. Bas itna samjho: inka place hai, par ye final swaroop nahi. Neti-Neti aur sakshi-bhav ek hi direction me le jaate hain. Sakshi-bhav kehta hai - jo uth raha hai, use dekho. Neti kehti hai - jo dekha ja raha hai, use final “main” mat maano.
#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj jab koi strong identity uthe, rukkar dekho. Body identity, mind identity, role identity ya old story - jo bhi ho. Dheere se kaho: “ye experience hai. Ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye mera final swaroop nahi. Neti. Ye bhi nahi.”

sections.heading: Dwitiya Khand - Sharir, Mann Aur Emotions Par Neti
blocks: Pichhle khand me humne Neti-Neti samjha. Ab ise experience me lana hai. Jab body me pain hota hai, mind me worry hoti hai, ya deep emotion uthta hai, to clarity dhundhli pad sakti hai. Tab body hi main lagti hai, mind hi main lagta hai, emotion hi main lagta hai. Isliye ab hum sharir, mann aur emotions par Neti ko apply karenge.

Sharir sabse paas lagta hai. Bhook, pyaas, thakan, pain, comfort - sab sharir ke through experience hota hai. Jab body healthy ho, mann kehta hai “main theek hoon.” Jab body ill ho, kehta hai “main toot gaya hoon.” Jab body achchi lage, ahankar kehta hai “main achcha hoon.” Jab body weak lage, kehta hai “main kam hoon.”

Neti ki drishti se dekho. Body badal rahi hai. States badal rahi hain - hunger, fullness, tiredness, energy, illness, health, comfort, pain. Jo constantly badalta hai woh final swaroop nahi ho sakta. Iska matlab body ko deny karna nahi. Pain hai to treatment, thakan hai to rest, weakness hai to nourishment. Lekin care karte hue clarity rahe: “pain body me hai. Thakan body me hai. Ye sab jaana ja raha hai. Main sirf body nahi.”

Pain ke time Neti ki test hoti hai. Body fine ho to kehna easy hai “main sharir nahi.” Lekin pain me identity chipak jati hai. Pain ko jhooth mat kaho, dabao mat, spiritual words se cover mat karo. Pain hai to pain hai. Bas jaano: “pain body ke is part me hai. Mind iske around story bana raha hai. Fear aa sakta hai. Worry aa sakti hai. Ye sab jaana ja raha hai.” Phir kaho: “ye body ki state hai. Ye final swaroop nahi. Neti.”
Neti pain hatane ki trick nahi. Ye identity clear karne ki direction hai. Pain reh sakta hai, treatment chal sakta hai. Lekin clarity aa sakti hai ki pain experience me hai; main sirf pain nahi.

Mann ko dekho. Mann thoughts, memories, desires, fears, imagination aur plans ka flow hai. Kabhi past, kabhi future, kabhi worry, kabhi fantasy, kabhi decision, kabhi confusion. Mann close lagta hai, isliye lagta hai “mere thoughts hi main hoon.” Lekin thoughts aate-jaate hain. Subah ek, dopahar dusra, shaam teesra. Old beliefs, opinions, desires aur fears badal gaye. To kya main har thought ke saath badal gaya?

Neti kehti hai: “ye thought hai. Ye mind movement hai. Ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye final swaroop nahi.” Thought ko rokna nahi. Thought ko enemy nahi banana. Mind kahe “main failure hoon” - dekho, thought hai. Mind kahe “mujhe respect chahiye” - dekho, desire-thought hai. Mind kahe “sab bigad jayega” - dekho, future imagination hai. Kaho: “ye bhi nahi. Neti.”

Emotions ko dekho. Emotion thought se deep lagta hai kyunki body me feel hota hai. Fear me body tight, anger me heat, dukh me heaviness, love me softness, joy me lightness. Emotion uthte hi identity ban jati hai - “main dukhi hoon”, “main gusse me hoon”, “main dara hua hoon”, “main khush hoon.” Emotion ko deny nahi karna. Dukh hai to dukh hai. Fear hai to fear hai. Lekin emotion ko dekho. Emotion aata hai, rehta hai, badalta hai, chala jata hai. Jo aata-jata hai woh final “main” nahi.

Emotion ko naam do. Kaho: “dukh hai”, “fear hai”, “anger hai.” Body me dekho - kahan feel ho raha hai? Chest, stomach, throat, breath? Phir dekho mind kaunsi story bana raha hai. Dukh ke upar story ho sakti hai “mere saath hamesha aisa hota hai.” Fear ke upar story “sab bigad jayega.” Ab gently kaho: emotion jaani ja rahi hai, body sensation jaani ja rahi hai, story jaani ja rahi hai - Neti.

Sukh par bhi Neti zaroori hai. Dukh aaya to “ye main nahi”, par sukh aaya to “yehi main” - ye bhi identity hai. Khushi, prem, shanti, anand beautiful hain. Inhe reject nahi karna. Par pakadna bhi nahi. Shanti aayi - jaani gayi. Anand aaya - jaana gaya. Sukh par Neti sukh ko kam nahi karti; pakad kam karti hai.

Neti me compassion chahiye. Body ill ho to harsh mat bano. Mind confused ho to self-blame mat karo. Emotion intense ho to use jaldi hataane ki koshish mat karo. Neti ka tone loving ho: “haan, ye experience hai. Ise dekho. Isme kho mat jao.”
#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas
Din me teen baar ruko aur poochho: body me kya chal raha hai? Mind me kaunsa thought ya story hai? Kaunsi emotion present hai? Phir kaho: “ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye mera final swaroop nahi. Neti.”

sections.heading: Tritiya Khand - Role, Kahani Aur Spiritual Identity Par Neti
blocks: Ab hum subtle identities dekhte hain - role, story, image aur spiritual identity. Ye itni normal lagti hain ki sadhak unhe identity samajhta hi nahi. “Main pita hoon”, “main maa hoon”, “main teacher hoon”, “main sadhak hoon”, “meri kahani kathin hai”, “mujhe gyaan hua.” Apne place par ye galat nahi. Vyavahar me roles hain, life me stories hain, society me image hai, sadhana me experiences hain. Lekin jab inme se koi final “main” ban jaye, ahankar ki pakad strong ho jati hai.

Roles necessary hain. Role responsibility batati hai. Neti role ko mitati nahi. Bas role ko final identity banne se rokhti hai. Role kehta hai - “ye mera karya hai.” Ahankar kehta hai - “yehi main hoon.” Pita ki role hai to prem se nibhao. Lekin andar uthe “meri baat hamesha maani jaye” - role identity ban rahi hai. Teacher ki role me sawal sun nahi pa rahe - role ahankar se jud rahi hai. Sadhak ki role me “main normal logon se gehra hoon” - spiritual identity ban rahi hai. Kaho: “ye role jaani ja rahi hai. Ye final swaroop nahi. Neti.”

Ek person din me roles badalta hai: parent, worker, friend, child, student, teacher. Roles badalti rehti hain. “Main hoon” ka basic sense bana rehta hai. Agar role final “main” hoti, to role badalte hi main badal jana chahiye tha. Par knowing presence bani rehti hai.

Image ko dekho. Image hai: log mujhe kaise dekhte hain? Good, spiritual, successful, sensitive, strong, special. Image ka practical place hai, par final identity nahi. Jab image hurt hoti hai, anubhavkarta kehta hai: “log kya sochenge?”, “meri izzat chali jayegi”, “meri spiritual image toot jayegi.” Image dusron ke mind me bani perception hai. Aaj praise, kal criticism. Jo dusron ke mind me banta-bigadta hai, woh final swaroop nahi. Kaho: “image ki chinta jaani ja rahi hai. Neti.”

Kahani ko dekho. Har person apni life story lekar chalta hai: “mere saath aisa hua”, “maine struggle kiya”, “mujhe koi nahi samjha”, “main alag hoon”, “main toot gaya”, “main strong hoon.” Story me sach ho sakta hai. Wounds real ho sakte hain. Achievements real ho sakti hain. Neti story ko jhooth nahi kehti. Bas poochti hai: kya story hi tum ho? Story memory me hai. Meaning badalta hai. Jo badalta hai final “main” nahi.

Victim story bhi dekho: “mere saath hamesha galat hua”, “kisi ne mujhe prem nahi diya.” Isme sach ho sakta hai. Hurt ko dekhna hai, compassion chahiye. Par pain ko permanent identity banana bondage hai. Wound ko dekho, wound mat bano. Special story bhi dekho: “main alag hoon”, “meri sadhana alag hai”, “mujhe koi samajh nahi sakta.” Specialness separation badhati hai. Neti kehti hai: “special hone ki feeling jaani ja rahi hai. Neti.”

Spiritual identity sabse subtle hai. Sadhana, knowledge, experience, seva, vinamrata aur awareness tak ko ahankar pakad sakta hai. “Main sadhak hoon” - Neti. “Main gyani hoon” - Neti. “Mujhe experience hua” - Neti. “Main sakshi me hoon” - Neti. “Main jag gaya hoon” - Neti. Iska matlab sadhana chhodna nahi. Sadhana karo, understanding ka respect karo, seva prem se karo. Par inme final identity mat banao.

“Main sakshi hoon” bhi pointer hai, final object nahi. Agar mind ise new spiritual ego bana de, to is thought ko bhi dekho: “sakshi hone ka thought uth raha hai - Neti.” Sakshi thought, role, image ya achievement nahi. Sakshi wahi knowing presence hai jisme ye sab jana ja raha hai.

Jab role, image, story aur spiritual identity par Neti hoti hai, natural humility aati hai. Sadhak dekhta hai ki jise “main” kehta tha, woh kitni layers se bana tha. Pakad dhili hoti hai. Woh zyada sun sakta hai, apni galti accept kar sakta hai, dusron ko chhota kiye bina apni disha me chal sakta hai.
#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas
Aaj ek role, story ya image ko dekho. Poochho: ye kaunsi identity hai? Kya ye badalti hai? Kya ye jaani ja rahi hai? Phir kaho: “ye bhi nahi. Neti.” Isse harsh mat banao; ise loving clarity banao.

sections.heading: Chaturth Khand - Neti Ke Baad Kya Bachta Hai?
blocks: Pichhle khand me humne subtle identities par Neti lagayi. Role hai, par main role nahi. Image hai, par main image nahi. Story hai, par main story nahi. Spiritual experience hai, par main experience nahi. “Main sadhak hoon”, “main gyani hoon”, “main special hoon”, “main wounded hoon” - ye sab known identities hain. Ab sawal uthta hai: agar main sharir nahi, mann nahi, emotion nahi, role nahi, story nahi, image nahi, spiritual identity bhi nahi - to phir main kya hoon?

Ye sawal fear la sakta hai. Ab tak “main” jin cheezon se bana lagta tha, woh ek-ek karke dekhi ja rahi hain. Mind poochta hai - “phir kya bacha?” Yahin Neti-Neti ka secret open hota hai. Neti tumhe empty karne ke liye nahi. Tumhe erase karne ke liye nahi. Neti false identity ko hatati hai, taki jo hamesha tha woh clear ho sake.

Jab tum kehte ho “main sharir nahi hoon”, kya tum disappear ho jate ho? Nahi. Sharir jaana ja raha hai. Jab kehte ho “main mann nahi hoon”, kya tum end ho jate ho? Nahi. Mann jaana ja raha hai. Jab kehte ho “main emotion nahi hoon”, kya knowing rukti hai? Nahi. Emotion jaana ja raha hai. Jab kehte ho “main kahani nahi hoon”, tab bhi kahani ko koi jaanta hai. To Neti ke baad blankness nahi; knowing aur clear hoti hai. Jo gir raha hai false identity hai. Jo bachta hai quiet knowing presence hai. Isi ko is course me sakshi kaha gaya hai.

Neti baar-baar sakshi ki taraf lautati hai. Body seen - main body nahi. Mind seen - main mind nahi. Emotion seen - main emotion nahi. Role seen - main role nahi. Story seen - main story nahi. Spiritual experience seen - main experience nahi. Attention us taraf jata hai jo ye sab jaanta hai. “Main sakshi hoon” ek useful pointer hai, par sakshi new role, thought, title ya achievement nahi. Sakshi woh quiet knowing presence hai jo sharir, mann, thought, bhav, sukh, dukh sabko jaanti hai, par unse badalti nahi.

Mind poochta hai: Neti ke baad kya bachta hai? Mind kisi object ka wait karta hai - light, peace, silence, bliss, special state. Lekin jo bhi experience ke roop me bachega, us par bhi Neti lagegi. Deep peace aayi - jaani gayi. Joy aaya - jaana gaya. Emptiness aayi - jaani gayi. Light ka experience aaya - jaana gaya. Silence ka experience aaya - jaana gaya. Jo jaana gaya, woh final knower nahi.

Neti karte-karte ek silence khul sakta hai. Ye sirf sound na hone ka silence nahi, pakad dhili hone ka silence hai. Pehle mind turant kehta tha “main”, “mera”, “mujhe chahiye.” Ab grip slow hoti hai. Body me experience hai, par turant “main” nahi. Thought hai, par belief turant nahi. Emotion hai, par identity turant nahi. Andar space khulta hai. Ye silence jaisa lag sakta hai. Par silence ko bhi pakadna nahi. Jo silence aata-jata hai woh experience hai. Jo uske aane-jaane ko jaanta hai, wahi sakshi ki disha hai.

Neti duniya se escape nahi hai. “Main body nahi” ka matlab body neglect nahi. “Main mind nahi” ka matlab insensitive hona nahi. “Main role nahi” ka matlab responsibility chhodna nahi. “Main story nahi” ka matlab life se learn karna band karna nahi. Neti life ko right place deti hai. Body care hoti hai, work hota hai, relations nibhate hain, emotions ko space milta hai, sadhana hoti hai - par final identity kisi se nahi banti.

Neti ka fruit life me dikhta hai. Criticism aaye, hurt ho sakta hai, par dekh sakte ho: “image touch hui - Neti.” Praise aaye, joy ho sakti hai, par dekh sakte ho: “recognition ka sukh hai - Neti.” Body thake, rest chahiye, par clarity rahe: “thakan body me hai - Neti.” Mind worry kare, planning ho sakti hai, par worry final truth nahi. Spiritual pride uthe, sadhak muskura kar dekhe: “ye bhi layer hai - Neti.”

Kab tak Neti? Jab tak identity changing cheezon se judti hai, Neti useful hai. Lekin Neti mechanical mantra nahi. Ye seeing ki art hai. Dheere-dheere seeing hi Neti ban jati hai. Sadhak dekhta hai: ye badal raha hai, ye final swaroop nahi. Aur woh quiet knowing presence me laut aata hai.

Is adhyay ka saar simple hai. Neti-Neti life ko reject nahi karti. Neti false identity ko dhila karti hai. Neti sakshi ki taraf lautne ki komal kala hai. Agla adhyay Mahavakya ki taraf le jayega - wo great statements jo direct truth ki taraf point karte hain. Neti ne kaha: “ye nahi.” Mahavakya poochega: “to phir kya?”

Priya sadhak, Neti ko gentle rakho. Ise harsh mat banao. Ise escape mat banao. Jab body, mind, emotion, role, story ya spiritual experience se identity bane, dekho - Neti. Phir shaant raho. Jo tum nahi ho, woh dheere-dheere dhila hoga. Jo tum ho, use banana nahi padega. Suraj ko light banne ka practice nahi karna padta. Badal hatte hain, light dikh jati hai. Neti clouds ko pehchanti hai; sun create nahi karti.
#### Is Hafte Ke Liye Abhyas

Agle saat din Neti-Neti ko gentle practice ki tarah rakho. Jab strong identity uthe, poochho: ye body se hai ya mind se? Emotion hai ya story? Role hai ya image? Spiritual experience hai ya spiritual ego? Phir kaho: “ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye badalne wala hai. Ye mera final swaroop nahi. Neti.” Phir kuch moments quiet raho. Light, bliss ya special state ka wait mat karo. Bas dekho - experiences aate jaate hain, aur knowing pehle se hai.

Neti-Neti ki simple kasauti hai: jo badalta hai, woh mera final swaroop nahi ho sakta. Sharir badalta hai, mann badalta hai, emotions badalte hain, thoughts badalte hain, roles badalte hain, image badalti hai, kahani ka meaning badalta hai, spiritual experiences bhi aate-jaate hain. To inme se koi final “main” nahi.

Ab dekho - ye sab badalte hue bhi kuch hai jo changes ko jaanta hai. Bachpan ka sharir badla, jaana gaya. Mann ki state badli, jaani gayi. Dukh aaya-gaya, jaana gaya. Success aayi-gayi, jaani gayi. Role badli, jaani gayi. Spiritual experience aaya, jaana gaya. To sadhak poochta hai - jo jaana ja raha hai, kya main wahi hoon? Ya main woh hoon jo ise jaan raha hai? Ye Neti-Neti ka heart hai.

Kapdon ka example lo. Tum kapde badalte ho. Kapde tumhare hain, par tum kapde nahi. Achchhe kapde pehne to “main achcha”, purane kapde pehne to “main kam” - ye confusion hai. Life me hum sharir, mann, role aur image ko bhi kapdon ki tarah pehente hain, lekin unhe “main” maan lete hain. Neti-Neti kehti hai - in garments ko pehchano, use karo, respect do, par final identity mat banao.

Nadi ka example lo. Tum kinare baithe ho, paani beh raha hai. Patte, phool, lakdi, mitti sab behkar aate-jaate hain. Agar har cheez ko pakadkar kaho “ye main hoon”, restless ho jaoge. Thoughts aur emotions bhi aise hi flow hain. “Main successful hoon”, “main failure hoon”, “mujhe respect chahiye”, “main spiritual hoon.” Neti-Neti kehti hai - ye thought bhi nahi, ye emotion bhi nahi, ye kahani bhi nahi, ye role bhi nahi.

Neti-Neti me komalta chahiye. Sharir ko blame mat karo. Mann ko enemy mat banao. Role ko reject mat karo. Kahani ka apmaan mat karo. Bas itna samjho: inka place hai, par ye final swaroop nahi. Neti-Neti aur sakshi-bhav ek hi direction me le jaate hain. Sakshi-bhav kehta hai - jo uth raha hai, use dekho. Neti kehti hai - jo dekha ja raha hai, use final “main” mat maano.

#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj jab koi strong identity uthe, rukkar dekho. Body identity, mind identity, role identity ya old story - jo bhi ho. Dheere se kaho: “ye experience hai. Ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye mera final swaroop nahi. Neti. Ye bhi nahi.”

### Dwitiya Khand - Sharir, Mann Aur Emotions Par Neti

Pichhle khand me humne Neti-Neti samjha. Ab ise experience me lana hai. Jab body me pain hota hai, mind me worry hoti hai, ya deep emotion uthta hai, to clarity dhundhli pad sakti hai. Tab body hi main lagti hai, mind hi main lagta hai, emotion hi main lagta hai. Isliye ab hum sharir, mann aur emotions par Neti ko apply karenge.

Sharir sabse paas lagta hai. Bhook, pyaas, thakan, pain, comfort - sab sharir ke through experience hota hai. Jab body healthy ho, mann kehta hai “main theek hoon.” Jab body ill ho, kehta hai “main toot gaya hoon.” Jab body achchi lage, ahankar kehta hai “main achcha hoon.” Jab body weak lage, kehta hai “main kam hoon.”

Neti ki drishti se dekho. Body badal rahi hai. States badal rahi hain - hunger, fullness, tiredness, energy, illness, health, comfort, pain. Jo constantly badalta hai woh final swaroop nahi ho sakta. Iska matlab body ko deny karna nahi. Pain hai to treatment, thakan hai to rest, weakness hai to nourishment. Lekin care karte hue clarity rahe: “pain body me hai. Thakan body me hai. Ye sab jaana ja raha hai. Main sirf body nahi.”

Pain ke time Neti ki test hoti hai. Body fine ho to kehna easy hai “main sharir nahi.” Lekin pain me identity chipak jati hai. Pain ko jhooth mat kaho, dabao mat, spiritual words se cover mat karo. Pain hai to pain hai. Bas jaano: “pain body ke is part me hai. Mind iske around story bana raha hai. Fear aa sakta hai. Worry aa sakti hai. Ye sab jaana ja raha hai.” Phir kaho: “ye body ki state hai. Ye final swaroop nahi. Neti.”

Neti pain hatane ki trick nahi. Ye identity clear karne ki direction hai. Pain reh sakta hai, treatment chal sakta hai. Lekin clarity aa sakti hai ki pain experience me hai; main sirf pain nahi.

Mann ko dekho. Mann thoughts, memories, desires, fears, imagination aur plans ka flow hai. Kabhi past, kabhi future, kabhi worry, kabhi fantasy, kabhi decision, kabhi confusion. Mann close lagta hai, isliye lagta hai “mere thoughts hi main hoon.” Lekin thoughts aate-jaate hain. Subah ek, dopahar dusra, shaam teesra. Old beliefs, opinions, desires aur fears badal gaye. To kya main har thought ke saath badal gaya?

Neti kehti hai: “ye thought hai. Ye mind movement hai. Ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye final swaroop nahi.” Thought ko rokna nahi. Thought ko enemy nahi banana. Mind kahe “main failure hoon” - dekho, thought hai. Mind kahe “mujhe respect chahiye” - dekho, desire-thought hai. Mind kahe “sab bigad jayega” - dekho, future imagination hai. Kaho: “ye bhi nahi. Neti.”

Emotions ko dekho. Emotion thought se deep lagta hai kyunki body me feel hota hai. Fear me body tight, anger me heat, dukh me heaviness, love me softness, joy me lightness. Emotion uthte hi identity ban jati hai - “main dukhi hoon”, “main gusse me hoon”, “main dara hua hoon”, “main khush hoon.” Emotion ko deny nahi karna. Dukh hai to dukh hai. Fear hai to fear hai. Lekin emotion ko dekho. Emotion aata hai, rehta hai, badalta hai, chala jata hai. Jo aata-jata hai woh final “main” nahi.

Emotion ko naam do. Kaho: “dukh hai”, “fear hai”, “anger hai.” Body me dekho - kahan feel ho raha hai? Chest, stomach, throat, breath? Phir dekho mind kaunsi story bana raha hai. Dukh ke upar story ho sakti hai “mere saath hamesha aisa hota hai.” Fear ke upar story “sab bigad jayega.” Ab gently kaho: emotion jaani ja rahi hai, body sensation jaani ja rahi hai, story jaani ja rahi hai - Neti.

Sukh par bhi Neti zaroori hai. Dukh aaya to “ye main nahi”, par sukh aaya to “yehi main” - ye bhi identity hai. Khushi, prem, shanti, anand beautiful hain. Inhe reject nahi karna. Par pakadna bhi nahi. Shanti aayi - jaani gayi. Anand aaya - jaana gaya. Sukh par Neti sukh ko kam nahi karti; pakad kam karti hai.

Neti me compassion chahiye. Body ill ho to harsh mat bano. Mind confused ho to self-blame mat karo. Emotion intense ho to use jaldi hataane ki koshish mat karo. Neti ka tone loving ho: “haan, ye experience hai. Ise dekho. Isme kho mat jao.”

#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Din me teen baar ruko aur poochho: body me kya chal raha hai? Mind me kaunsa thought ya story hai? Kaunsi emotion present hai? Phir kaho: “ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye mera final swaroop nahi. Neti.”

### Tritiya Khand - Role, Kahani Aur Spiritual Identity Par Neti

Ab hum subtle identities dekhte hain - role, story, image aur spiritual identity. Ye itni normal lagti hain ki sadhak unhe identity samajhta hi nahi. “Main pita hoon”, “main maa hoon”, “main teacher hoon”, “main sadhak hoon”, “meri kahani kathin hai”, “mujhe gyaan hua.” Apne place par ye galat nahi. Vyavahar me roles hain, life me stories hain, society me image hai, sadhana me experiences hain. Lekin jab inme se koi final “main” ban jaye, ahankar ki pakad strong ho jati hai.

Roles necessary hain. Role responsibility batati hai. Neti role ko mitati nahi. Bas role ko final identity banne se rokhti hai. Role kehta hai - “ye mera karya hai.” Ahankar kehta hai - “yehi main hoon.” Pita ki role hai to prem se nibhao. Lekin andar uthe “meri baat hamesha maani jaye” - role identity ban rahi hai. Teacher ki role me sawal sun nahi pa rahe - role ahankar se jud rahi hai. Sadhak ki role me “main normal logon se gehra hoon” - spiritual identity ban rahi hai. Kaho: “ye role jaani ja rahi hai. Ye final swaroop nahi. Neti.”

Ek person din me roles badalta hai: parent, worker, friend, child, student, teacher. Roles badalti rehti hain. “Main hoon” ka basic sense bana rehta hai. Agar role final “main” hoti, to role badalte hi main badal jana chahiye tha. Par knowing presence bani rehti hai.

Image ko dekho. Image hai: log mujhe kaise dekhte hain? Good, spiritual, successful, sensitive, strong, special. Image ka practical place hai, par final identity nahi. Jab image hurt hoti hai, anubhavkarta kehta hai: “log kya sochenge?”, “meri izzat chali jayegi”, “meri spiritual image toot jayegi.” Image dusron ke mind me bani perception hai. Aaj praise, kal criticism. Jo dusron ke mind me banta-bigadta hai, woh final swaroop nahi. Kaho: “image ki chinta jaani ja rahi hai. Neti.”

Kahani ko dekho. Har person apni life story lekar chalta hai: “mere saath aisa hua”, “maine struggle kiya”, “mujhe koi nahi samjha”, “main alag hoon”, “main toot gaya”, “main strong hoon.” Story me sach ho sakta hai. Wounds real ho sakte hain. Achievements real ho sakti hain. Neti story ko jhooth nahi kehti. Bas poochti hai: kya story hi tum ho? Story memory me hai. Meaning badalta hai. Jo badalta hai final “main” nahi.

Victim story bhi dekho: “mere saath hamesha galat hua”, “kisi ne mujhe prem nahi diya.” Isme sach ho sakta hai. Hurt ko dekhna hai, compassion chahiye. Par pain ko permanent identity banana bondage hai. Wound ko dekho, wound mat bano. Special story bhi dekho: “main alag hoon”, “meri sadhana alag hai”, “mujhe koi samajh nahi sakta.” Specialness separation badhati hai. Neti kehti hai: “special hone ki feeling jaani ja rahi hai. Neti.”

Spiritual identity sabse subtle hai. Sadhana, knowledge, experience, seva, vinamrata aur awareness tak ko ahankar pakad sakta hai. “Main sadhak hoon” - Neti. “Main gyani hoon” - Neti. “Mujhe experience hua” - Neti. “Main sakshi me hoon” - Neti. “Main jag gaya hoon” - Neti. Iska matlab sadhana chhodna nahi. Sadhana karo, understanding ka respect karo, seva prem se karo. Par inme final identity mat banao.

“Main sakshi hoon” bhi pointer hai, final object nahi. Agar mind ise new spiritual ego bana de, to is thought ko bhi dekho: “sakshi hone ka thought uth raha hai - Neti.” Sakshi thought, role, image ya achievement nahi. Sakshi wahi knowing presence hai jisme ye sab jana ja raha hai.

Jab role, image, story aur spiritual identity par Neti hoti hai, natural humility aati hai. Sadhak dekhta hai ki jise “main” kehta tha, woh kitni layers se bana tha. Pakad dhili hoti hai. Woh zyada sun sakta hai, apni galti accept kar sakta hai, dusron ko chhota kiye bina apni disha me chal sakta hai.

#### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj ek role, story ya image ko dekho. Poochho: ye kaunsi identity hai? Kya ye badalti hai? Kya ye jaani ja rahi hai? Phir kaho: “ye bhi nahi. Neti.” Isse harsh mat banao; ise loving clarity banao.

### Chaturth Khand - Neti Ke Baad Kya Bachta Hai?

Pichhle khand me humne subtle identities par Neti lagayi. Role hai, par main role nahi. Image hai, par main image nahi. Story hai, par main story nahi. Spiritual experience hai, par main experience nahi. “Main sadhak hoon”, “main gyani hoon”, “main special hoon”, “main wounded hoon” - ye sab known identities hain. Ab sawal uthta hai: agar main sharir nahi, mann nahi, emotion nahi, role nahi, story nahi, image nahi, spiritual identity bhi nahi - to phir main kya hoon?

Ye sawal fear la sakta hai. Ab tak “main” jin cheezon se bana lagta tha, woh ek-ek karke dekhi ja rahi hain. Mind poochta hai - “phir kya bacha?” Yahin Neti-Neti ka secret open hota hai. Neti tumhe empty karne ke liye nahi. Tumhe erase karne ke liye nahi. Neti false identity ko hatati hai, taki jo hamesha tha woh clear ho sake.

Jab tum kehte ho “main sharir nahi hoon”, kya tum disappear ho jate ho? Nahi. Sharir jaana ja raha hai. Jab kehte ho “main mann nahi hoon”, kya tum end ho jate ho? Nahi. Mann jaana ja raha hai. Jab kehte ho “main emotion nahi hoon”, kya knowing rukti hai? Nahi. Emotion jaana ja raha hai. Jab kehte ho “main kahani nahi hoon”, tab bhi kahani ko koi jaanta hai. To Neti ke baad blankness nahi; knowing aur clear hoti hai. Jo gir raha hai false identity hai. Jo bachta hai quiet knowing presence hai. Isi ko is course me sakshi kaha gaya hai.

Neti baar-baar sakshi ki taraf lautati hai. Body seen - main body nahi. Mind seen - main mind nahi. Emotion seen - main emotion nahi. Role seen - main role nahi. Story seen - main story nahi. Spiritual experience seen - main experience nahi. Attention us taraf jata hai jo ye sab jaanta hai. “Main sakshi hoon” ek useful pointer hai, par sakshi new role, thought, title ya achievement nahi. Sakshi woh quiet knowing presence hai jo sharir, mann, thought, bhav, sukh, dukh sabko jaanti hai, par unse badalti nahi.

Mind poochta hai: Neti ke baad kya bachta hai? Mind kisi object ka wait karta hai - light, peace, silence, bliss, special state. Lekin jo bhi experience ke roop me bachega, us par bhi Neti lagegi. Deep peace aayi - jaani gayi. Joy aaya - jaana gaya. Emptiness aayi - jaani gayi. Light ka experience aaya - jaana gaya. Silence ka experience aaya - jaana gaya. Jo jaana gaya, woh final knower nahi.

Neti karte-karte ek silence khul sakta hai. Ye sirf sound na hone ka silence nahi, pakad dhili hone ka silence hai. Pehle mind turant kehta tha “main”, “mera”, “mujhe chahiye.” Ab grip slow hoti hai. Body me experience hai, par turant “main” nahi. Thought hai, par belief turant nahi. Emotion hai, par identity turant nahi. Andar space khulta hai. Ye silence jaisa lag sakta hai. Par silence ko bhi pakadna nahi. Jo silence aata-jata hai woh experience hai. Jo uske aane-jaane ko jaanta hai, wahi sakshi ki disha hai.

Neti duniya se escape nahi hai. “Main body nahi” ka matlab body neglect nahi. “Main mind nahi” ka matlab insensitive hona nahi. “Main role nahi” ka matlab responsibility chhodna nahi. “Main story nahi” ka matlab life se learn karna band karna nahi. Neti life ko right place deti hai. Body care hoti hai, work hota hai, relations nibhate hain, emotions ko space milta hai, sadhana hoti hai - par final identity kisi se nahi banti.

Neti ka fruit life me dikhta hai. Criticism aaye, hurt ho sakta hai, par dekh sakte ho: “image touch hui - Neti.” Praise aaye, joy ho sakti hai, par dekh sakte ho: “recognition ka sukh hai - Neti.” Body thake, rest chahiye, par clarity rahe: “thakan body me hai - Neti.” Mind worry kare, planning ho sakti hai, par worry final truth nahi. Spiritual pride uthe, sadhak muskura kar dekhe: “ye bhi layer hai - Neti.”

Kab tak Neti? Jab tak identity changing cheezon se judti hai, Neti useful hai. Lekin Neti mechanical mantra nahi. Ye seeing ki art hai. Dheere-dheere seeing hi Neti ban jati hai. Sadhak dekhta hai: ye badal raha hai, ye final swaroop nahi. Aur woh quiet knowing presence me laut aata hai.

Is adhyay ka saar simple hai. Neti-Neti life ko reject nahi karti. Neti false identity ko dhila karti hai. Neti sakshi ki taraf lautne ki komal kala hai. Agla adhyay Mahavakya ki taraf le jayega - wo great statements jo direct truth ki taraf point karte hain. Neti ne kaha: “ye nahi.” Mahavakya poochega: “to phir kya?”

Priya sadhak, Neti ko gentle rakho. Ise harsh mat banao. Ise escape mat banao. Jab body, mind, emotion, role, story ya spiritual experience se identity bane, dekho - Neti. Phir shaant raho. Jo tum nahi ho, woh dheere-dheere dhila hoga. Jo tum ho, use banana nahi padega. Suraj ko light banne ka practice nahi karna padta. Badal hatte hain, light dikh jati hai. Neti clouds ko pehchanti hai; sun create nahi karti.

#### Is Hafte Ke Liye Abhyas

Agle saat din Neti-Neti ko gentle practice ki tarah rakho. Jab strong identity uthe, poochho: ye body se hai ya mind se? Emotion hai ya story? Role hai ya image? Spiritual experience hai ya spiritual ego? Phir kaho: “ye jaana ja raha hai. Ye badalne wala hai. Ye mera final swaroop nahi. Neti.” Phir kuch moments quiet raho. Light, bliss ya special state ka wait mat karo. Bas dekho - experiences aate jaate hain, aur knowing pehle se hai.
